definitions.explanation: On the same day as another event or action; immediately without delay.

examples.japanese: {即日|そくじつ}{配達|はいたつ}できます。
{申|もう}し{込|こ}み{即日|そくじつ}から{使|つか}える。
examples.english: You can use it from the same day you apply.

examples.japanese: {結果|けっか}は{即日|そくじつ}{発表|はっぴょう}されます。
examples.english: The results will be announced on the same day.

notes:
{即日|そくじつ} emphasizes that something happens on the very same day as another event, with no waiting period. Often used as a noun modifier before another noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即日|そくじつ}{配達|はいたつ}: same-day delivery
- {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}: same-day shipping
- {即日|そくじつ}{回答|かいとう}: same-day response
- {即日|そくじつ}{開票|かいひょう}: same-day vote counting
- {即日|そくじつ}{完売|かんばい}: sold out on the same day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {当日|とうじつ}: on that day, the day in question (neutral — does not emphasize speed)
- {本日|ほんじつ}: today (formal, used in announcements)
- {即日|そくじつ} specifically highlights the speed or immediacy, implying no delay

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in business, advertising, and official announcements. In casual speech, その{日|ひ}のうちに (within that day) is more natural.
